definitions.explanation: A major geological fault line or boundary that defines the structural framework of a landmass. In Japanese geography, several named tectonic lines divide the Japanese islands into distinct geological zones.

examples.japanese: {中央構造線|ちゅうおうこうぞうせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日本最大|にほんさいだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{構造線|こうぞうせん}だ。
examples.english: The Median Tectonic Line is Japan's largest tectonic line.

examples.japanese: {構造線|こうぞうせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{分布|ぶんぷ}→分布：00021_bunpu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many hot springs are distributed along the tectonic line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{構造線|こうぞうせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{位置|いち}している→位置する：09891_ichisuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Areas with frequent earthquakes are often located near tectonic lines.

notes:
A geological term composed of ⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧ (structure) and ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line). Japan has several major tectonic lines that are important in geography education and earthquake science.

MAJOR JAPANESE TECTONIC LINES:
- {中央構造線|ちゅうおうこうぞうせん}: Median Tectonic Line — the longest fault in Japan, running from Kyushu to the Kanto region
- {糸魚川静岡構造線|いといがわしずおかこうぞうせん}: Itoigawa-Shizuoka Tectonic Line — divides Honshu's geology into eastern and western halves
- {柏崎千葉構造線|かしわざきちばこうぞうせん}: Kashiwazaki-Chiba Tectonic Line

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {構造線|こうぞうせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧: along the tectonic line
- {活|かつ}{構造線|こうぞうせん}: active tectonic line

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{断層|だんそう}→断層：06367_dansou⟧: fault — a fracture in rock where displacement has occurred
